name: Mark Kinner
background: Mark Kinner of Sheridan served in the Wyoming House from 2015 to 2022, representing House District 29. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born July 23, 1952, in Danbury, Connecticut; listed a B.S. from the University of Wyoming; and identified him as a retired banker. Civic roles listed there included former chairman and board member of Sheridan College, former chairman of the Sheridan Community Land Trust, and former chairman and board member of Forward Sheridan. It said he was married to his wife, Tibbie, and had two children.

sources.name: Wyoming Trucking Association and Associated General Contractors of Wyoming, 2021–2022 Directory of the Sixty-Sixth Legislature
